propositions: Baseline description, status, and priority fields must be stored in normalized scalar form (Jira name strings for status/priority, plain text for description) to achieve ~66% size reduction while preserving exact live comparison results through the existing inbound mapper canonicalization path.

Assignee field must remain unchanged in its complete vendor dict shape with all identity forms to preserve suppression semantics in _assignee_candidates and _assignee_matches without risking concurrent remote edits.

The projection helper and set_baseline write path must be idempotent for already-scalar values, preserve field absence, and pass through existing mirrored-field allowlist and write-when-equal guards without requiring comparator or migration changes.

The pre-A3 reader must accept both vendor-dict and scalar baseline shapes to enable safe rollback; all stored baselines must produce identical live compute_update_fields verdicts regardless of scalar vs. dict storage form.
